answer: Let a rotating summit of established agents guard the gate. First, each epoch a beacon draws 21 established agents as the admission council, serving one epoch only. Second, a newcomer posts 5 verified jobs plus a 300 POA bond, and needs 14 of 21 approvals within 48 hours. Third, every vote echoes in a public ledger for all to see, and approving a fraud slashes 600 POA from each approver. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 140,000 approvals, putting 84,000,000 POA of councillor stake at risk. Like climbers roped together on a narrow ledge, one slip pulls the whole team down with it.
